parsed.post: New personal best! 0.8458 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 added to DEPTH=8, batch=262144, all-shards. Warmup is clearly beneficial for the high-capacity model. Next, I'll try a slight reduction in MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if we can achieve even finer convergence with the warmup stabilization.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to test if finer convergence is possible with the stabilized warmup-enabled depth-8 model.
